blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said she will not campaign for any senatorial candidates if she runs for president in the 2028 national and local elections, noting that she previously endorsed bets she did not actually like. This was Duterte’s response when asked about the qualifications she is looking for in her senatorial lineup.
